description: This file is a source module for course-related operations in a frontend application, providing functions to fetch course data, lessons, progress, and handle notes, interacting with a backend database via Supabase.

methods.name: mapCourse(row)
methods.description: Transforms a database row into a course object with normalized fields.

methods.name: mapLesson(row)
methods.description: Transforms a database row into a lesson object with normalized fields.

methods.name: mapProgress(row)
methods.description: Transforms a database row into a progress object with completed lessons and percentage.

methods.name: isUnauthorized(error)
methods.description: Checks if an error object corresponds to an unauthorized error (e.g., JWT or auth failure).

methods.name: fetchCourses({ page = 1, pageSize = 12, search = '', category = '', level = '', sortBy = 'updated_at', sortDir = 'desc' } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of courses with optional filters, sorting, and search.

methods.name: fetchCourseById(courseId)
methods.description: Fetches detailed information of a single course by its ID.

methods.name: fetchLessons(courseId)
methods.description: Retrieves lessons associated with a specific course.

methods.name: fetchProgress(courseId, userId)
methods.description: Retrieves user progress for a specific course.

methods.name: saveNote({ courseId, lessonId, userId, content })
methods.description: Saves or updates a user note for a lesson.

methods.name: fetchNotes({ courseId, lessonId, userId })
methods.description: Retrieves user notes for a specific lesson.

methods.name: markLessonComplete({ courseId, lessonId, userId })
methods.description: Marks a lesson as completed for user progress tracking via a stored procedure.

ctags.name: fetchCourses
ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchCourses({ page = 1, pageSize = 12, search = '', category = '', level /
ctags.signature: ({ page = 1, pageSize = 12, search = '', category = '', level = '', sortBy = 'updated_at', sortDir = 'desc' } = {})

ctags.pattern: /^export async function fetchNotes({ courseId, lessonId, userId }) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export async function markLessonComplete({ courseId, lessonId, userId }) {$/

ctags.pattern: /^export async function saveNote({ courseId, lessonId, userId, content }) {$/
